guard: the production pty runtime adopts a live proxy and a runtime without adopt still refuses by name
why: The refusal cell is the earliest expectRed and is reached through production requireRuntimeAdopt. The production adopt cell is a later, separate observation of a live proxy from CustodialPtyRuntime.adopt.

mutations.name: M1 swallow the absent-adopt refusal
mutations.find:
if (typeof runtime.adopt !== "function")
    throw new Error(`runtime "${runtime.kind}" does not support adopt`);
mutations.replace:
if (typeof runtime.adopt !== "function")
    return runtime.spawn("unused", { command: "true", args: [] }, ".");
mutations.expectRed: absent adopt refuses by runtime name
mutations.cell: absent adopt refuses by runtime name
mutations.note: Code-only unique anchor on the production refusal. Fixture spawn still throws, so the named cell reddens because the adopt message is gone.

mutations.name: M2 return a dead handle from production adopt
mutations.find: return adoptSeatSync(loadSeat(this.root, reference.id)) as unknown as AgentHandle;
mutations.replace: return { name: "dead", kind: "pty", pid: -1, status: () => "exited", stop: () => {}, interrupt: () => {}, attach: () => { throw new Error("no"); } } as unknown as AgentHandle;
mutations.expectRed: production adopt returns a live proxy
mutations.cell: production adopt returns a live proxy
mutations.note: The mutation is only the adopt return. Spawn still launches a real seat; the successor proxy is what must stay live.
